run_validation: run fairseq model validation on a dataset subset using the validate CLI
run_main: run the main validation loop loading models and computing loss on validation data
run_cli_main: run the CLI entry point to parse args and start distributed validation
review_main: review the main function that loads models, builds criterion, and iterates over validation batches
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that parses validation args and calls distributed_utils.call_main
